title: AIxDaily
overview_zh: 今日精选：AI × Chem 16 项，AI × Bio 12 项，AI × Math 10 项，AI Voices 9 项，Engineering 9 项。今日五频道共同日期为 2026-10-07。化学与生物前三项均为预印本，重点在酶活性位点设计、mRNA密码子建模、非经典结晶，以及多模态临床证据、轴向干细胞和脓毒症肺损伤机制；数学同样以预印本为主，聚焦自动形式化、可验证辩论和 Lean 搜索。AI Voices 汇总 X 上的公开观点与厂商发布信息，工程频道则是 GitHub Trending 项目，不等同于同行评议或正式软件版本。今日前三项未见可明确归为同行评议论文的条目。

channel_highlights.aixchem: 前三项均为预印本：CaGE 进行复杂酶活性位点设计并有晶体结构与活性验证；Trias 学习密码子约束服务 mRNA 设计；另一项用非经典结晶调控单晶形貌。
channel_highlights.aixbio: 前三项均为预印本：MM-KG 显式连接多模态患者证据与知识图谱；研究捕获人类轴向干细胞状态；单细胞分析提出脓毒症肺损伤中的 KLF6 互作线索。
channel_highlights.aixmath: 前三项均为预印本：AIProver 结合证书验证与演化 harness 做自动形式化；另两项分别研究多智能体辩论读出和 Lean4 持久化证明搜索。
channel_highlights.aivoices: 均为 X 公开帖文而非论文：Mistral 预告 Large 4 与开放权重计划；另一帖分享 AI 全栈教程；OpenAI 预告公开模型生成的数学成果。
channel_highlights.engineering: 前三项是 GitHub Trending 工具：text-to-CAD 面向自然语言 CAD，另两项改善 AI 设计与编码智能体输出；不等同正式版本发布。

breaking_news.headline_zh: 预印本主张反驳 3SUM 与 APSP 假设，并提供 Lean 形式化
breaking_news.summary_zh: 研究者在公开帖子中介绍一篇新预印本：其主张给出反驳 Randomized Integer Word-RAM 3SUM 猜想的算法，并声称同时处理 APSP 与 Exact Triangle 假设；帖子称该算法由 Anthropic 的 Claude 发现，论文附有 Lean 形式化。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 若主张经核验，将触及理论计算机科学长期开放问题，并把 AI 发现、算法构造与机器可检验证明连成可复用流程；目前仍是论文主张。

breaking_news.headline_zh: OpenAI 发布内部前沿模型产出的722篇数学手稿，涵盖多项开放问题
breaking_news.summary_zh: 公开帖子转述 OpenAI 新仓库：内部未命名前沿模型从约4000个问题中筛选结果，发布722篇手稿、372项结果，涉及 Catalan 常数、黎曼 ζ 函数零点带、Hodge 猜想等，部分成果尚未 Lean 形式化。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 规模与问题跨度把模型产出的数学主张置于集中核验场景；若关键结果成立，可能改变研究者筛题、证明和复核的分工，但现阶段仍需逐项验证。

breaking_news.headline_zh: Mistral 发布 Large 4：一万亿参数原生多模态模型，API 即日开放
breaking_news.summary_zh: Mistral AI 官方公布 Large 4：总参数约一万亿、激活参数约490亿，原生处理多模态输入，在网络安全、制造、金融和视觉定位任务上宣称达到或超过闭源前沿模型；API 已可用，开放权重计划月底发布。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 它把超大规模稀疏模型、原生多模态和欧洲云端部署合并为可直接调用的产品；若开放权重按计划落地，将扩大前沿模型的可部署生态。

items.title: Complex enzyme active site scaffolding by iteratively detuned catalytic guidance
items.abstract_or_text: De novo enzyme design requires sequences whose structures reproduce prescribed catalytic geometries. This remains challenging for active sites that couple multiple catalytic residues, cofactors and substrates. Here we introduce the Catalytic Guidance Engine (CaGE), which optimizes designed sequences to satisfy complex sets of functional constraints by alternating constraint guided structure prediction trajectories with sequence design, gradually fading the strength of the constraint information over cycles to nudge the designed sequence towards satisfying all the constraints. We train RF3 to accept atom-pair distances and other design conditions, and use classifier-free guidance to fade their influence over multiple design cycles. We also develop training-free motif guidance protocols which operate at inference time by directly adjusting selected atoms towards the design target geometry during diffusion sampling. CaGE improves catalytic-motif geometry across a diverse enzyme benchmark and yields sequences that recover complex target active sites in independent AF3 predictions. We experimentally demonstrate the power of CaGE by designing active enzymes with complex catalytic sites: a nonheme-iron design positions four active-site residues around an iron centre and a transition-state ligand, and a PLP-dependent design positions four catalytic residues around a PLP cofactor with multiple functional groups. Active site substitutions and a 2.7[A] crystal structure support the designed mechanisms and structures. Thus, CaGE provides a route to functional de novo enzymes with complex active sites.
items.summary_zh: 提出 CaGE，通过逐轮减弱催化约束引导结构预测与序列设计，构建具有复杂活性位点的从头设计酶，并以非血红素铁酶和 PLP 依赖酶验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文同时给出独立 AF3 预测和 2.7 Å 晶体结构支持，且完成酶活实验，是候选集中从生成模型走向结构与功能验证较完整的工作；但摘要未报告更广泛的催化性能范围和成功率。
items.abstract_zh: 从头设计酶需要其序列形成能够复现预定催化几何构型的结构。对于耦合多个催化残基、辅因子和底物的活性位点，这仍然具有挑战性。我们在此提出催化引导引擎（Catalytic Guidance Engine，CaGE），通过交替进行约束引导的结构预测轨迹和序列设计来优化设计序列，使其满足复杂的功能约束；在多个设计周期中逐渐减弱约束信息的强度，从而推动设计序列满足所有约束。我们训练 RF3 接受原子对距离和其他设计条件，并使用无分类器引导，在多个设计周期中逐渐减弱这些条件的影响。我们还开发了无需训练的基序引导协议，在推理时通过在扩散采样过程中直接调整选定原子，使其趋向目标几何构型。CaGE 在多样化的酶基准上改善了催化基序几何构型，并生成了能够在独立 AF3 预测中恢复复杂目标活性位点的序列。我们通过设计具有复杂催化位点的活性酶，实验性地展示了 CaGE 的能力：一个非血红素铁设计将四个活性位点残基定位在铁中心和过渡态配体周围；一个依赖 PLP 的设计将四个催化残基定位在带有多个官能团的 PLP 辅因子周围。活性位点替换实验和 2.7 Å 晶体结构支持所设计的机制和结构。因此，CaGE 为具有复杂活性位点的功能性从头设计酶提供了一条途径。

items.title: A generative language model decodes contextual constraints on codon choice for mRNA design
items.abstract_or_text: Synonymous codon choice affects mRNA fate and protein output, posing a challenge for mRNA technology. Design of therapeutic mRNAs requires a model that captures biological nuance from natural sequences while identifying constraints relevant to synthetic expression. We present Trias, a generative encoder-decoder language model trained on millions of vertebrate coding sequences that successfully designs mRNAs with high protein output. Trias learns codon usage rules directly from sequence data, integrating local and global dependencies to generate species-specific codon sequences that reflect biological constraints. Without explicit training on protein expression, its zero-shot predictions correlate strongly with experimental measurements of mRNA stability and protein output. Moreover, we show experimentally that novel sequences generated by Trias for a therapeutically relevant target produce more protein than existing methods, demonstrating that preferences learned from natural sequences can lead to high output from synthetic sequences. Released open source with full code and weights, Trias provides a reproducible framework for synthetic mRNA design that reveals molecular and evolutionary principles behind codon choice.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Trias 生成式编码器—解码器模型，从数百万条脊椎动物编码序列中学习密码子选择的局部与全局约束，并用于高表达 mRNA 设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型在未直接使用蛋白表达训练的情况下与 mRNA 稳定性和蛋白产量实验测量高度相关，且新设计序列在治疗相关靶标上提高了蛋白产量；但验证对象和表达体系仍有限。
items.abstract_zh: 同义密码子的选择会影响 mRNA 的命运和蛋白质产量，这给 mRNA 技术带来了挑战。治疗性 mRNA 的设计需要一种能够从天然序列中捕获生物学细微差异、同时识别与合成表达相关约束的模型。我们提出 Trias，这是一种在数百万条脊椎动物编码序列上训练的生成式编码器—解码器语言模型，能够设计出蛋白质产量高的 mRNA。Trias 直接从序列数据中学习密码子使用规则，整合局部和全局依赖关系，生成反映生物学约束的物种特异性密码子序列。在没有针对蛋白质表达进行显式训练的情况下，其零样本预测与 mRNA 稳定性和蛋白质产量的实验测量高度相关。此外，我们通过实验表明，Trias 为一个具有治疗相关性的靶标生成的新序列比现有方法产生更多蛋白质，说明从天然序列中学习到的偏好可以带来高表达的合成序列。Trias 以完整代码和权重开放发布，为合成 mRNA 设计提供了可复现的框架，并揭示了密码子选择背后的分子和进化原理。
items.author_line: Faizi, M., Sakharova, H., Borrmann, H., Parsa, M. S., Lareau, L. F.

items.title: Shaping single crystals through a controlled non-classical crystallization pathway
items.abstract_or_text: The ability to program the shape of single crystals through molten-state processing has transformed the manufacturing of inorganic materials, yet this strategy is fundamentally incompatible with most organic-based crystals, which decompose before melting. Here, we show that a non-classical crystallization pathway can overcome this limitation by generating a moldable dense-liquid intermediate during the growth of peptide-based metal-organic frameworks (MOFs). By engineering a reaction environment in which precursor concentration and reagent diffusion are controlled while suppressing convection, we selectively activate a liquid-liquid phase separation process to produce a confined dense-liquid phase that can be shaped prior to crystallization. Repeated diffusion-limited chemical perturbations subsequently transform this intermediate into single crystals that faithfully preserve the geometry of the confined environment in which they form, enabling non-equilibrium morphologies inaccessible by conventional synthesis. We further show that crystal shape influences mechanical properties, demonstrating that controlling crystallization pathways provides a route to tailor function without altering chemical composition.
items.summary_zh: 利用肽基 MOF 生长过程中的致密液体中间体和液—液相分离，在结晶前塑造单晶形状，并展示形状对机械性能的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把非经典结晶路径转化为有机晶体形貌和性能调控手段，无需改变化学组成即可获得常规合成难以实现的非平衡形貌；但摘要未给出形貌尺寸范围、重复性和长期稳定性。
items.abstract_zh: 通过熔融态加工来编程单晶形状的能力已经改变了无机材料的制造方式，但由于大多数有机基晶体在熔化前就会分解，这一策略与它们根本不相容。在此我们展示，一条非经典结晶路径可以通过在肽基金属有机框架（MOF）生长过程中生成可模塑的致密液体中间体来克服这一限制。通过设计前驱体浓度和试剂扩散受到控制、同时抑制对流的反应环境，我们选择性地激活液—液相分离过程，形成一个能够在结晶前塑形的受限致密液相。随后，反复进行扩散受限的化学扰动，使该中间体转化为单晶；所得单晶忠实保留其形成时受限环境的几何形状，从而实现常规合成无法获得的非平衡形貌。我们进一步表明，晶体形状会影响机械性能，说明在不改变化学组成的情况下控制结晶路径可以成为调节功能的一条途径。
items.author_line: Thao Nguyen, João Pedro Vale, Oriol Arteaga, Annalisa Calò, James D. Nicholas, Roc Matheu, Mario Palacios-Corella, Andriu Cavegn, Maria Guix, Alessandro Sorrenti, Salvador Pané, Tiago Sotto Mayor, Josep Puigmartí-Luis

items.title: Dynamic Flow Experimentation for Data-Rich Polymer Synthesis
items.abstract_or_text: Growing global challenges in healthcare, energy, sustainability, and technology have motivated increased automation and robotics to accelerate material discovery and development. Continuous droplet flow chemistry has provided a solution to non-uniform mixing and transport phenomena and provides the advantages of batch reactions for screening individual reaction conditions and reagent compositions. Dynamic experimentation in flow chemistry enables the exploration of a broad design space while minimizing the use of reagents and time by continuously varying reaction parameters (such as temperature, concentration, reaction time). Here, an automated polymer synthesis platform with dynamic experimentation capabilities was implemented. The platform leveraged syringe pumps, a custom uniform irradiance photochemical reactor with tunable temperature control, inline Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), and an online benchtop nuclear magnetic resonance spectrometry (NMR) at 80 MHz for automated and data-rich polymer synthesis. The combination of inline FTIR, online NMR, and offline (500 MHz) NMR enabled cross-validation between analytical techniques, and parity plots comparing data between the techniques had an R 2 value greater than 0.99 for the dynamic experiment exploring the PET-RAFT homopolymerization of methyl acrylate. Dynamic experimentation was also used to explore the copolymerization of methyl acrylate and dimethylacrylamide. The obtained rich data were used to generate accurate Gaussian process regression models for the polymerization reactions with R 2 values greater than 0.9 for parity plots of the model vs experimental monomer conversion values. The Gaussian process regression model of the copolymerization was used to understand copolymerization reaction kinetics by determining reactivity ratios under various light intensity and temperature conditions.
items.summary_zh: 构建带有在线 FTIR、在线 NMR 和可调温光化学反应器的自动化动态流动聚合平台，系统探索 PET-RAFT 均聚和共聚反应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多种分析手段交叉验证的 R² 超过0.99，并用高信息量数据训练出 R² 超过0.9 的高斯过程模型，展示了动态实验对聚合动力学和反应性比研究的价值；但当前验证集中于特定单体体系。
items.abstract_zh: 医疗、能源、可持续性和技术领域日益增长的全球挑战，推动了自动化和机器人技术的发展，以加速材料发现和开发。连续液滴流动化学为非均匀混合和传输现象提供了解决方案，同时具有批式反应筛选单独反应条件和试剂组成的优势。流动化学中的动态实验能够在连续改变反应参数（例如温度、浓度和反应时间）的同时探索广泛的设计空间，并最大限度地减少试剂和时间的使用。在此，我们实现了一个具备动态实验能力的自动化聚合合成平台。该平台采用注射泵、带可调温度控制的定制均匀辐照光化学反应器、在线傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）以及一台80 MHz 在线台式核磁共振波谱仪（NMR），用于自动化和数据丰富的聚合合成。在线 FTIR、在线 NMR 和离线（500 MHz）NMR 的结合，使不同分析技术之间能够进行交叉验证；在探索丙烯酸甲酯 PET-RAFT 均聚的动态实验中，各技术数据之间的 parity plot 的 R² 值大于0.99。动态实验还被用于探索丙烯酸甲酯和二甲基丙烯酰胺的共聚。所得丰富数据用于为聚合反应生成准确的高斯过程回归模型，模型与实验单体转化率之间的 parity plot 的 R² 值大于0.9。该共聚反应的高斯过程回归模型被用于理解共聚反应动力学，并确定不同光强和温度条件下的反应性比。
items.author_line: Dylan J. Walsh, Katharina A. Fransen, Alexander Bentley, Federico Florit, Klavs F. Jensen, Bradley D. Olsen

items.title: FREA: A Multi-Source Expert Benchmark for Reaction Feasibility Verification
items.abstract_or_text: As generative models and AI agents propose chemical reactions at a scale beyond expert review, feasibility verifiers decide which proposals enter synthesis planning. But do their decisions agree with chemists across different kinds of candidates? We introduce FREA, a benchmark of 751 reactions labeled by expert chemists under an explicit feasibility criterion, drawn from retrosynthesis model proposals, zero-yield experimental records, edits by large language models (LLMs), and five negative candidate generation methods. Our evaluation finds that no verifier leads across all sources: LLMs given only the criterion are competitive with dedicated verifiers, while forward models perform best on retrosynthesis proposals but reject most feasible edits of recorded reactions at the evaluated operating points. Looking beyond aggregate scores, both forward models perform below chance when separating infeasible alternative disconnections from feasible generated candidates. To study whether negative supervision addresses these weaknesses, we also release a corpus of over 14 million recorded reactions and generated negative candidates. In matched training comparisons, adding a mixture of generated negatives to forward training raises mean AUROC across sources, but these gains do not extend to retrosynthesis proposals. Varying the generation method further shows that the largest gain on generated candidates coincides with worse proposal screening. These findings motivate evaluating verifiers against experts across sources and designing negatives for transfer to model proposals.
items.summary_zh: 发布 FREA 基准，汇集751个由专家标注的反应，比较不同来源候选上的可行性验证器，并提供超过1400万条反应与负候选数据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它揭示验证器在不同候选来源之间存在明显迁移失效，并用专家标注、跨来源评测和负样本实验拆解误差来源；但结论依赖所选专家标准与候选生成分布。
items.abstract_zh: 随着生成模型和 AI 智能体以超出专家审查能力的规模提出化学反应，可行性验证器决定哪些方案能够进入合成规划。但在不同类型的候选物上，它们的判断是否与化学家一致？我们提出 FREA，这是一个包含751个反应的基准，这些反应由化学家专家依据明确的可行性标准进行标注，来源包括逆合成模型提出的反应、零收率实验记录、大语言模型（LLM）的编辑，以及五种负候选生成方法。我们的评估发现，没有任何验证器能够在所有来源上领先：只获得可行性标准的 LLM 与专用验证器相比具有竞争力；前向模型在逆合成候选上表现最好，但在所评估的运行点会拒绝大多数对已记录反应的可行编辑。进一步超越总体分数的分析显示，在区分不可行的替代断键与可行的生成候选时，两个前向模型的表现都低于随机水平。为研究负监督能否解决这些弱点，我们还发布了一个包含超过1400万条已记录反应和生成负候选的语料库。在匹配的训练比较中，向前向模型训练加入混合生成负样本，提高了跨来源的平均 AUROC，但这种提升没有扩展到逆合成候选。进一步改变生成方法表明，在生成候选上的最大提升与更差的候选筛选同时出现。这些发现支持针对不同来源评估验证器与专家的一致性，并设计能够迁移到模型提议上的负样本。
items.author_line: Botao Yu, Bo Zhou, Daniel Adu-Ampratwum, Frazier N. Baker, Ziru Chen, Reza Averly, Ye Liu, Wenhao Gao, Xia Ning, Huan Sun

items.title: PharmAgent: Constraint-Aware Search with Frozen Language Models for Molecular Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular optimization must improve target activity and satisfy developability constraints within limited evaluation budgets. Classical methods require tailored rules or training to incorporate chemical instructions and property feedback. Frozen language models can condition edits on this information, but need explicit constraint control and relevant experience. We therefore present PharmAgent, a constraint-aware molecular search method driven by adaptive external state. Its Lagrangian controller translates violations in accepted states into accumulated constraint pressure, keeping this history separate from current property measurements. Structure-indexed replay complements this feedback with relevant evaluated transitions that guide subsequent proposals. As a curriculum progressively activates constraints, candidates and the incumbent are compared under the same current objective, and the accepted state determines the next multiplier update. We derive an exact identity that characterizes how accepted-state violations accumulate in the controller's multipliers. Across five tasks with five independent runs, PharmAgent achieves a summed area under the target-score curves (AUC) of 3.9208 in target-only search, improving over MOLLEO by 37.3%. With online constraints, it achieves a property-adjusted AUC of 0.7076, improving over the strongest online baseline, ExLLM, by 53.8%. These results rank first among all evaluated methods in both target-only and constraint-aware search. The online comparison covers all five baseline frameworks. The full system leads every ablation variant in target quality, property-adjusted performance, and Pareto hypervolume. All five molecular cases reach feasible final states, documenting target gains and trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: 提出 PharmAgent，通过拉格朗日约束控制器、结构索引回放和逐步启用约束，在有限评估预算下进行分子优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在五项任务和五次独立运行中，目标分数 AUC 和约束调整后 AUC 均超过基线，且所有分子案例达到可行终态；但实验规模较小，尚未证明对真实实验闭环的收益。
items.abstract_zh: 分子优化必须在有限的评估预算内提高靶点活性并满足可开发性约束。经典方法需要定制规则或训练，以纳入化学指令和性质反馈。冻结语言模型可以基于这些信息调节编辑，但需要显式的约束控制和相关经验。因此，我们提出 PharmAgent，这是一种由自适应外部状态驱动的约束感知分子搜索方法。其拉格朗日控制器将已接受状态中的违反约束行为转化为累积的约束压力，并将这一历史与当前性质测量分开保存。结构索引回放机制补充了这一反馈，利用相关的已评估转移来指导后续提案。随着课程学习逐步激活约束，候选物和当前最优解在相同的当前目标下进行比较，而被接受的状态决定下一次乘子更新。我们推导出一个精确恒等式，用于刻画已接受状态中的约束违反如何在控制器乘子中累积。在五项任务的五次独立运行中，PharmAgent 在仅优化靶点的搜索中取得3.9208的目标分数曲线下面积（AUC），比 MOLLEO 提高37.3%。在带在线约束的搜索中，它取得0.7076的性质调整后 AUC，比最强的在线基线 ExLLM 提高53.8%。在目标优化和约束感知搜索中，这些结果均在所有评估方法中排名第一。在线比较覆盖了全部五个基线框架。完整系统在目标质量、性质调整后性能和 Pareto 超体积方面均领先于所有消融变体。五个分子案例最终都达到可行状态，记录了目标增益及其权衡。
items.author_line: Nihui Shao, Guanxing Chen, Jilong Shi, Zhengyang Bai, Haohuai He, Zhenchao Tang, Qiujie Lv, Yu-An Huang, Zhi-An Huang

items.title: Bridging the Evidence-to-Execution Gap:A Reflective Agent for Multi-Objective Peptide Design
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) can reason over scientific literature to devise design strategies, yet fail to reliably implement them for biological sequences. While protein generative models learn sequence patterns, they lack the capacity to incorporate literature evidence for multi-step reflective reasoning, forming an evidence-to-execution gap between scientific reasoning and sequence manipulation. We present EASER (Evidence-Aware Sequence Engineering with Reflection), a reflective agent bridging reasoning and sequence generation via a learned property interface of offline-trained, fixed low-rank matrices. The agent steers a diffusion generator by combining these matrices, proposing intervention hypotheses (anchors, editable positions, control coefficients) grounded in retrieved evidence, sequence context and past results. A Probe-and-Steer mechanism validates interventions and allocates samples according to predicted property responses, with outcome reflection informing subsequent decisions. Evaluated on multi-objective antimicrobial peptide design (optimizing activity, non-hemolysis and non-toxicity), explicit hypothesis formulation delivers better multi-objective performance than direct action generation under identical decision conditions. Ablation studies verify the importance of evidence retrieval, episodic history, reflection and Probe-and-Steer. Over six repeated trials, EASER obtains the highest mean hypervolume and lowest mean IGD+ on screened candidates compared with competing baselines. Our work demonstrates how an executable property interface and iterative feedback link scientific reasoning to targeted peptide sequence generation.
items.summary_zh: 提出 EASER 反思式智能体，把文献检索证据、可学习性质接口和 Probe-and-Steer 机制接入扩散模型，用于多目标抗菌肽设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在相同决策条件下，显式假设形成和反思优于直接生成，并通过消融及六次重复试验证明组件贡献；但评估仍基于筛选候选，尚未给出体外或体内验证。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）能够对科学文献进行推理以制定设计策略，但无法可靠地将这些策略应用于生物序列。蛋白质生成模型能够学习序列模式，却缺乏纳入文献证据进行多步骤反思推理的能力，从而形成科学推理与序列操作之间的证据—执行鸿沟。我们提出 EASER（Evidence-Aware Sequence Engineering with Reflection），这是一种反思式智能体，通过一个由离线训练的固定低秩矩阵构成的可学习性质接口，连接推理与序列生成。该智能体通过组合这些矩阵来引导扩散生成器，提出基于检索证据、序列上下文和过去结果的干预假设（锚点、可编辑位置和控制系数）。Probe-and-Steer 机制验证干预并根据预测的性质响应分配样本，同时利用结果反思来指导后续决策。在多目标抗菌肽设计上进行评估时，优化活性、非溶血性和非毒性，在相同决策条件下，显式假设形成带来了优于直接行动生成的多目标性能。消融研究验证了证据检索、情景历史、反思以及 Probe-and-Steer 的重要性。在六次重复试验中，与竞争基线相比，EASER 在筛选候选物上取得最高的平均超体积和最低的平均 IGD+。我们的工作表明，可执行的性质接口和迭代反馈能够将科学推理与面向目标的肽序列生成连接起来。
items.author_line: Haosen Zhang, Yang Yang

items.title: From Benchmark to Bench: Can Agents Survive Real-World Drug Discovery?
items.abstract_or_text: Agentic systems increasingly coordinate molecular-design tools, but it is unclear which layer of the stack limits outcomes on real projects. We developed MAGI, an open modular agent that authors objectives, launches and monitors optimization, interprets structure activity relationships, and revises its strategy accordingly. MAGI generates molecules either directly through the LLM or by delegating to REINVENT4, with scoring services interchangeable behind a common contract. We tested it across nine retrospective lead-optimization campaigns from three pharmaceutical companies, replayed under fixed temporal cutoffs. Both routes produced valid structures: LLM proposals stayed closer to local chemistry and reached comparable or higher primary activity in fewer operations, whereas REINVENT explored broader chemical space. Whether a campaign met its objective depended on the predictive models, not on the generation route: attainment followed model accuracy on the chemistry proposed, dropping once that chemistry moved outside the model applicability domain. Separately, a blinded evaluation asked whether the MAGI output could pass as expert work: chemists were not able to discriminate agentic proposals from held-out compounds, and judged the SAR reasoning broadly plausible yet incomplete. Together, these results position MAGI as a coordination layer pluggable into existing computational chemistry workflows. The ceiling on real projects, however, remains currently set by scorer applicability rather than by tool orchestration.
items.summary_zh: 提出 MAGI 开放模块化智能体，在九个来自三家药企的历史先导优化项目中比较 LLM 直接提案与 REINVENT4 委托路线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果把真实项目的瓶颈定位到评分模型的适用域，而非工具编排，并有盲法化学家评估；但研究是回放实验，不能替代前瞻性合成与生物测试。
items.abstract_zh: 智能体系统越来越多地协调分子设计工具，但目前尚不清楚在真实项目中是哪一层限制了结果。我们开发了 MAGI，这是一种开放的模块化智能体，能够编写目标、启动并监控优化、解释构效关系，并相应地修订策略。MAGI 既可以直接通过 LLM 生成分子，也可以将任务委托给 REINVENT4，评分服务则通过一个通用契约实现可互换。我们在来自三家制药公司的九个历史先导优化项目上进行了测试，并在固定的时间截点下重放。两条路线都产生了有效结构：LLM 提案更接近局部化学空间，并以更少的操作达到相当或更高的主要活性，而 REINVENT 探索了更宽广的化学空间。一个项目能否达到目标，取决于预测模型，而不是生成路线：当所提出的化学空间超出模型适用域后，目标达成率会随模型对该化学空间的准确性下降而下降。另一项盲法评估询问 MAGI 的输出能否被认为是专家工作：化学家无法将智能体提案与保留化合物区分开，并认为其构效关系推理总体上合理但不完整。总体而言，这些结果将 MAGI 定位为可插入现有计算化学工作流的协调层。然而，真实项目的上限目前仍由评分器的适用性决定，而不是由工具编排决定。
items.author_line: Llompart, P., Guner, L., Lai, H., Tibo, A., Xu, Y.

items.title: Optimizing the Optimizer: Language Models Discover Faster Molecular Relaxation
items.abstract_or_text: Geometry optimization is a major cost in many quantum-chemical workflows: each optimization step requires one force evaluation, and at the density-functional level that evaluation dominates the wall time. Research in this area has produced a broad range of optimization methods, and we ask whether a language model can improve on the best of them through autoresearch. An agent rewrites the optimizer itself to minimize force-call counts, restrained by two admission gates that reject premature stopping and improvements that do not generalize to unseen molecules. Starting from Sella, the fastest open-source optimizer available, the search produces AutoSella, a family of two optimizers. Both of them deliver consistent force-call reductions relative to Sella across held-out molecular benchmarks and potentials not used during the search. Most notably, at the r2SCAN-3c DFT level, the best variant requires only 40.2--77.2\% of Sella's force calls while achieving the same energy reduction, even though agent used no DFT gradients.
items.summary_zh: 让语言模型通过自动研究重写 Sella 优化器，得到 AutoSella，并在未见分子和势能上减少几何优化所需的力调用次数。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 r2SCAN-3c DFT 上最佳变体只需 Sella 40.2–77.2% 的力调用即可达到相同能量降低，且通过未见基准测试了泛化；但摘要未说明不同分子类别上的失败模式。
items.abstract_zh: 几何优化是许多量子化学工作流中的主要成本：每个优化步骤都需要一次力评估，而在密度泛函理论层面，这种评估占据主要计算时间。该领域的研究已经产生了广泛的优化方法，我们提出的问题是，语言模型能否通过自动研究超越其中最优方法。一个智能体重写优化器本身，以最小化力调用次数，同时受到两个准入门控机制的约束：它们拒绝过早停止，以及拒绝在未见分子上无法泛化的改进。以最快的开源优化器 Sella 为起点，该搜索产生了两个优化器组成的 AutoSella 系列。二者在保留的分子基准和搜索过程中未使用的势能上，都相对于 Sella 持续减少力调用次数。尤其是在 r2SCAN-3c DFT 层面，最佳变体只需要 Sella 40.2--77.2 ext{\%} 的力调用次数，同时实现相同的能量降低，尽管智能体没有使用 DFT 梯度。
items.author_line: Artem Tsypin, Vladimir Deshchenya, Kuzma Khrabrov, Denis Potapov, Maxim Radchenko, Artur Kadurin, Michael G. Medvedev

items.title: Agentic campaign control for high-throughput de novo binder design
items.abstract_or_text: Progress in artificial intelligence has produced a rapidly growing ecosystem of methods for de novo protein design. With access to many specialized and often complementary tools, how does one use them effectively, especially with a finite compute budget? Here, we introduce Target adaptive Rescue-Explore-eXploit (T-REX), an agentic protein binder design framework that orchestrates multiple state-of-the-art protein generative models and structure evaluators. Over the course of a design campaign, T-REX leverages large language model (LLM) agents to reason over accumulating outcomes and decide whether to rescue promising candidates, explore alternative settings, or exploit productive routes, while a deterministic controller validates and schedules proposed actions. Across seven targets, we find that T-REX adaptively allocates its compute across methods in a target-dependent manner and achieves the highest throughput of structurally distinct hits compared to all baselines. These results suggest that adaptive orchestration can complement increasingly powerful protein design models, and we openly release T-REX to support compute-efficient binder design workflows.
items.summary_zh: 提出 T-REX，使用 LLM 智能体在多种蛋白生成模型和结构评估器之间进行目标自适应的救援、探索和利用调度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在七个靶标上以有限计算预算获得最多结构不同的命中，说明智能体编排可补充单一生成模型；但摘要未提供命中物的实验结合验证。
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能的发展催生了快速增长的从头蛋白质设计方法生态。面对许多专门化且往往互补的工具，尤其是在计算预算有限的情况下，如何有效使用它们？在此，我们提出目标自适应 Rescue-Explore-eXploit（T-REX），这是一种智能体式蛋白质结合体设计框架，能够编排多种最先进的蛋白质生成模型和结构评估器。在设计活动过程中，T-REX 利用大语言模型（LLM）智能体对不断累积的结果进行推理，并决定是挽救有前景的候选物、探索替代设置，还是利用高产路线；同时，一个确定性控制器验证并调度所提出的行动。在七个靶标上，我们发现 T-REX 能够根据靶标以自适应方式在不同方法之间分配计算资源，并且与所有基线相比，获得了数量最多的结构不同命中物。这些结果表明，自适应编排可以补充日益强大的蛋白质设计模型；我们还公开发布 T-REX，以支持计算高效的结合体设计工作流。
items.author_line: Jeon, M., Song, J., Kim, J., Zhong, E. D.

items.title: ManifoldCache: Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration via Constraint Manifold Caching
items.abstract_or_text: Diffusion models for structured scientific generation must produce samples satisfying hard geometric constraints imposed by physics, chemistry, or biology, yet inference in these settings is prohibitively slow, demanding hundreds to thousands of neural-function evaluations per sample. We unify eight state-of-the-art models spanning medical volumetrics, molecular conformations, protein backbone design, crystal structure prediction, and multi-view 3D scenes under a single abstraction, Constraint-Manifold Diffusion Models (CMDMs), in which the target distribution is supported on a manifold defined by an externally specified constraint map. All existing acceleration families fail on this class: quantization exhausts memory on high-dimensional volumetric operators; pruning breaks constraint fidelity; fast ODE solvers allow trajectories to drift off the constraint manifold; and feature-caching heuristics are blind to constraint geometry, inducing mode confusion in the high-noise regime. We introduce ManifoldCache, the first training-free, data-free accelerator designed from first principles for CMDMs. The key insight is that the conditional score decomposes orthogonally into a normal component, which enforces constraint satisfaction, and a tangential component, which navigates within the manifold. Exploiting this structure, we prove that the noise-schedule midpoint is a sharp safe-caching boundary: caching before it incurs provably bounded error, while caching after it guarantees a strictly positive fraction of trajectories suffer mode confusion, a gap that persists up to the boundary. We further prove that deeper network blocks admit provably larger certified cache strides within the safe phase, as a consequence of the score decomposition propagating through block Jacobians. The resulting schedule requires no calibration data, along with zero training overhead.
items.summary_zh: 提出 ManifoldCache，从约束流形上的法向与切向得分分解出发，为分子构象、蛋白骨架和晶体结构等扩散模型提供无需训练和数据的加速。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 给出安全缓存边界和网络深层可认证步长的理论结果，并覆盖多类受硬约束的科学生成任务；但摘要未给出具体加速比例和各任务的保真度数值。
items.abstract_zh: 用于结构化科学生成的扩散模型必须生成满足物理、化学或生物学硬几何约束的样本，但在这些设置下推理速度极慢，每个样本需要数百到数千次神经函数评估。我们将涵盖医学体数据、分子构象、蛋白质骨架设计、晶体结构预测和多视角3D场景的八个最先进模型，统一到约束流形扩散模型（CMDM）这一抽象下；在该抽象中，目标分布支撑在由外部指定约束映射定义的流形上。现有的所有加速方法在这一类问题上都失效：量化会耗尽高维体数据算子的内存；剪枝会破坏约束保真度；快速 ODE 求解器会使轨迹偏离约束流形；特征缓存启发式方法则忽视约束几何，在高噪声区域导致模式混淆。我们提出 ManifoldCache，这是首个从第一性原理出发、无需训练且无需数据、专为 CMDM 设计的加速器。其关键洞见是，条件得分可以正交分解为法向分量和切向分量：前者强制满足约束，后者在流形内导航。我们证明，噪声调度的中点是一个严格的安全缓存边界：在此之前缓存会产生有理论界限的误差，而在此之后缓存则保证有严格正比例的轨迹遭遇模式混淆；这一差距一直持续到该边界。我们进一步证明，由于得分分解通过模块雅可比矩阵传播，更深的网络模块在安全阶段允许经过理论认证的更大缓存步长。由此得到的调度不需要校准数据，也不需要训练开销。
items.author_line: Prashant Pandey, Devineni Sri Venkatraya Chowdary, Brejesh Lall

items.title: Mechanistic classification of the AAA superfamily with protein language models
items.abstract_or_text: The ATPases Associated with various cellular Activites (AAA) are a class of proteins with diverse structure-function relationships whereby conserved 3-dimensional architecture is employed in varied mechanistic contexts. While cryo-electron microscopy has revealed extensive mechanistic data, predicting how specific sequence elements dictate unique biochemical mechanisms remains a challenge. Here, we present a machine learning framework to resolve these sequence-function relationships. We established a hierarchical classification scheme based on five distinct modes of coupling ATP hydrolysis to mechanical work. Using CatFunc, a lightweight protein language model (PLM)-based pipeline, we leveraged evolutionary context from millions of protein sequences for supervised classification of AAA domains based on mechanism. We observed excellent recall of our mechanistic annotations in masked validation studies, demonstrating that domain level context is sufficient to encapsulate the various observed mechanisms. Notably, systematic misclassifications revealed a shared evolutionary and mechanistic ancestry within the rotary motor class. Applying the model to out-of-distribution proteomic datasets, we established metrics to detect unrepresented functions. Our framework provides a scalable strategy for decoding molecular function from sequence data, offering a transferable approach for other biomedically important families such as membrane transporters, G protein-coupled receptors and kinases.
items.summary_zh: 使用轻量蛋白语言模型 CatFunc，对 AAA ATPase 家族按 ATP 水解与机械功耦合机制分层分类，并检测分布外功能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把序列表示与机制层级分类连接起来，并用掩码验证和分布外蛋白组数据检验可迁移性；但摘要未报告分类规模、基线和具体召回率。
items.abstract_zh: 与多种细胞活动相关的 ATPase（AAA）是一类具有多样结构—功能关系的蛋白质，它们利用保守的三维架构来实现不同的机制背景。尽管冷冻电镜已经揭示了大量机制数据，但预测特定序列元件如何决定独特的生化机制仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出一个机器学习框架来解析这些序列—功能关系。我们根据 ATP 水解与机械功耦合的五种不同模式，建立了一个分层分类体系。利用 CatFunc 这一基于轻量蛋白语言模型（PLM）的流程，我们借助数百万条蛋白质序列中的进化背景，对 AAA 结构域按机制进行监督分类。在掩码验证研究中，我们观察到机制注释具有很高的召回率，表明结构域层面的上下文足以概括所观察到的各种机制。值得注意的是，系统性误分类揭示了旋转马达类别内部共享的进化和机制祖先。将模型应用于分布外蛋白组数据集后，我们建立了用于检测未表示功能的指标。我们的框架为从序列数据中规模化解码分子功能提供了策略，也为其他具有生物医学重要性的蛋白质家族（如膜转运体、G 蛋白偶联受体和激酶）提供了可迁移的方法。
items.author_line: Swan, J. A., Hill, C. P.

items.title: GRASP: Graph Representation Learning with Assay Supervision for Molecular Properties
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular structures are abundant, while experimental bioactivity is sparse and distributed across assays. We introduce GRASP, a 93.5M-parameter graph Transformer that learns from these sources in sequence. GRASP first learns molecular structure through replaced-token detection on 1.54 billion ZINC20 molecule presentations, then adapts to sparse bioactivity across 642 ChEMBL assays. Across 23 cluster-held-out OpenADMET endpoints, GRASP achieves a mean MAE of 0.374, compared with 0.383 for CheMeleon, 0.408 for ECFP4-LightGBM, and 0.440 for Chemprop. ChEMBL adaptation reduces mean MAE from 0.407 to 0.374 and improves 21 of 23 endpoints, showing the value of intermediate bioactivity supervision. On 22 TDC ADMET tasks, GRASP gives a better point estimate than CheMeleon on 13 tasks. These results support staged molecular representation learning, where abundant molecular structure and sparse experimental measurements provide complementary supervision at different stages of training.
items.summary_zh: 提出 GRASP 图 Transformer，先在1.54 billion次 ZINC20 分子呈现上学习结构，再利用642个 ChEMBL assay 进行生物活性适配。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在23个 cluster-held-out OpenADMET endpoint 上优于 CheMeleon、ECFP4-LightGBM 和 Chemprop，并显示中间生物活性监督的增益；但仍属预印本，外部数据分布下的泛化需要进一步验证。
items.abstract_zh: 分子结构数量丰富，而实验生物活性数据稀疏且分散在不同 assay 中。我们提出 GRASP，这是一种拥有93.5M参数的图 Transformer，按顺序从这些数据源中学习。GRASP 首先在1.54 billion次 ZINC20 分子呈现上，通过替换标记检测学习分子结构；随后在642个 ChEMBL assay 的稀疏生物活性数据上进行适配。在23个 cluster-held-out OpenADMET endpoint 上，GRASP 的平均 MAE 为0.374，而 CheMeleon 为0.383，ECFP4-LightGBM 为0.408，Chemprop 为0.440。ChEMBL 适配使平均 MAE 从0.407降至0.374，并在23个 endpoint 中的21个上得到改善，显示了中间生物活性监督的价值。在22个 TDC ADMET 任务上，GRASP 在13个任务中给出了优于 CheMeleon 的点估计。这些结果支持分阶段的分子表示学习：丰富的分子结构和稀疏的实验测量在训练的不同阶段提供互补监督。
items.author_line: Srivastava, S. P., Gorantla, R., Singh, H., Chundru, S. K., Mey, A., SINGH, R. K.

items.title: ColdDDI: Evaluating Knowledge Utilization in Cold-Start Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Cold-start drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction tests whether models can identify clinically significant interactions for drugs without training-time interaction history. Existing benchmarks mostly report aggregate edge-prediction scores, leaving a key evaluation question unanswered: when models receive molecular, textual, or knowledge-graph (KG) evidence, do they actually use the evidence that pharmacologically supports the interaction? We introduce ColdDDI, a reconstructible diagnostic benchmark built from DrugBank 5.1.13, with 1,900 approved small-molecule drugs and 565,731 positive DDI pairs. ColdDDI evaluates pairs with zero, one, or two unseen drugs. It also annotates each interaction by whether it changes drug exposure or drug effect, and by whether the biomedical knowledge graph contains shared enzymes, transporters, or targets that can plausibly mediate the interaction. These annotations separate evidence availability from predictive dependence. We evaluate eight conventional DDI methods and 13 LLMs; for open-weight LLMs, we test five prompt patterns and use masking, drug replacement, and channel-sensitivity metrics to probe knowledge utilization. ColdDDI exposes that, in the hardest split where both drugs are unseen, the main performance divide is mediator availability. A fine-tuned 1B LLM recovers 89-93% of interactions with a shared enzyme, transporter, or target, but only 40-62% without such a mediator. More importantly, KG-provided evidence is not always used; several KG-augmented baselines change little when the shared mediator is masked or disrupted, whereas fine-tuned LLMs respond strongly to this intervention. Thus, ColdDDI evaluates knowledge utilization rather than knowledge access alone, showing where cold-start DDI models rely on mechanistic evidence and where they fail despite receiving it. Code is available at https://github.com/0217ljh/ColdDDI-NeurIPS2026.
items.summary_zh: 发布 ColdDDI 冷启动药物相互作用诊断基准，标注未知药物对、暴露或效应变化及共享酶、转运体和靶点等机制证据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它区分模型是否真正利用药理证据，而不只是获得知识；遮蔽实验显示知识图谱增强模型可能忽略共享 mediator，具有明确的诊断价值，但仍依赖 DrugBank 标注覆盖。
items.abstract_zh: 冷启动药物—药物相互作用（DDI）预测检验模型能否为没有训练阶段相互作用历史的药物识别具有临床意义的相互作用。现有基准大多报告总体边预测分数，却留下了一个关键评估问题：当模型接收分子、文本或知识图谱（KG）证据时，它们是否真正使用支持该相互作用的药理学证据？我们提出 ColdDDI，这是一个基于 DrugBank 5.1.13、可重建的诊断基准，包含1900种已批准小分子药物和565,731个阳性 DDI 对。ColdDDI 评估包含零个、一个或两个未见药物的药物对。它还根据相互作用是改变药物暴露还是改变药物效应进行标注，并标明生物医学知识图谱中是否存在可能介导相互作用的共享酶、转运体或靶点。这些标注将证据可获得性与预测依赖性区分开来。我们评估了八种常规 DDI 方法和13个 LLM；对于开放权重 LLM，我们测试了五种提示模式，并使用遮蔽、药物替换和通道敏感性指标来探查知识利用。在最困难的两个药物都未见过的划分中，ColdDDI 显示主要性能差异来自 mediator 的可获得性。一个经过微调的1B LLM 能够恢复89–93%具有共享酶、转运体或靶点的相互作用，但对于没有这些 mediator 的相互作用只能恢复40–62%。更重要的是，KG 提供的证据并不总被利用；当共享 mediator 被遮蔽或破坏时，若干 KG 增强基线的结果变化很小，而经过微调的 LLM 对这一干预反应强烈。因此，ColdDDI 评估的是知识利用，而不仅是知识获取，揭示了冷启动 DDI 模型在依赖机制证据的地方，以及尽管获得证据仍会失败的地方。代码可在 https://github.com/0217ljh/ColdDDI-NeurIPS2026 获取。

items.title: Neural Kinetics: Learning Kinetics as Transport in Compositional Space
items.abstract_or_text: Complex bio-derived and fossil mixtures contain thousands of molecules whose individual structures and reaction pathways cannot be fully resolved, making conventional mechanism-based kinetic modelling impractical. A reaction network detailed enough to describe every formula-level transformation would contain far more reactions and parameters than the available data can constrain. We propose to overcome this limitation by representing mixtures directly as abundance fields on a compositional grid indexed by molecular descriptors, specifically carbon number (#C) and double-bond equivalent (DBE), and by learning a time-conditioned, chemistry-informed operator that maps the initial composition to predict a later state. The evolution rates of the chemical space are learned by a two-dimensional Fourier neural operator (FNO) acting jointly on a set of heteroatom classes, with normalized time and compositional coordinates appended as input channels. Because experimental data are limited, we enlarge the training set with synthetic trajectories generated from the measured samples, pre-train on this ensemble, and then calibrate a small subset of parameters on the measured distributions. We tested the framework on a case of oxidation of a complex hydrocarbon mixture that is tracked by FTICR-MS over sixty seconds of reaction. On an independent sample the framework, that we named NeuralKinetics, reproduced the measured endpoint class composition within a mean absolute error of approximately one percent and arranged the heteroatom classes correctly on the compositional grid. The second test was an entirely different system: litter decomposition in a peatland warming experiment, also followed by FTICR-MS but over two years. The developed operator accurately predicted the endpoint class composition of the held-out sample proving that the framework is flexible enough to adapt to diverse reactive systems.
items.summary_zh: 提出 NeuralKinetics，以碳数和 DBE 组成网格表示复杂混合物，并用二维 Fourier neural operator 学习其随时间的反应演化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在氧化烃混合物和两年尺度泥炭地分解数据上，对独立样本端点组成达到约1%的 MAE，体现跨体系迁移潜力；但摘要未说明中间时间点和不确定性校准。
items.abstract_zh: 复杂的生物来源和化石来源混合物包含数千种分子，其单独结构和反应路径无法被完全解析，因此传统的基于机制的动力学建模并不切实际。一个足够详细、能够描述每个分子式层面转化的反应网络，会包含远多于可用数据所能约束的反应和参数。我们提出通过直接将混合物表示为组成网格上的丰度场来克服这一限制，该组成网格由分子描述符索引，具体为碳数（#C）和双键等效数（DBE）；并学习一个具有化学信息的时间条件算子，将初始组成映射为后续状态。化学空间的演化速率由二维 Fourier neural operator（FNO）学习，该算子在一组杂原子类别上联合运行，并将归一化时间和组成坐标作为输入通道附加进去。由于实验数据有限，我们使用从实测样本生成的合成轨迹扩充训练集，在此集合上进行预训练，然后在实测分布上校准少量参数。我们在一个复杂烃混合物氧化案例上测试了该框架；该过程由 FTICR-MS 跟踪60秒。在独立样本上，我们提出的框架 NeuralKinetics 以约1%的平均绝对误差复现了测量到的终点类别组成，并正确地在组成网格上排列了杂原子类别。第二项测试是一个完全不同的系统：泥炭地增温实验中的凋落物分解，同样由 FTICR-MS 跟踪，但时间跨度为两年。所开发的算子准确预测了留出样本的终点类别组成，证明该框架足够灵活，能够适应多样的反应体系。

items.title: A review on foundation models for polymer informatics
items.abstract_or_text: Foundation models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning transferable knowledge from broad, heterogeneous data and adapting them to diverse downstream tasks, driving a growing interest in AI-accelerated scientific discovery. In polymer science, this paradigm offers a promising route beyond conventional machine learning methods that are often confined to isolated tasks and struggle to generalize under data scarcity and across heterogeneous downstream settings. Polymer foundation models (PFMs), however, are not merely general scientific foundation models applied to polymer datasets. They must address representation, generation, transfer, and evaluation challenges specific to polymer informatics. This review synthesizes recent progress in PFMs for representation learning and generative modeling, spanning models designed for polymer systems and those adapted from general foundation models. We organize this review around two stages: (1) polymer modeling as the foundation, covering representations, datasets, model architectures, and pretraining objectives; and (2) downstream applications, evaluation, and adaptation. By synthesizing recent progress, open challenges, and future directions, this review outlines a roadmap toward robust and generalizable foundation models for polymer informatics.
items.summary_zh: 综述聚合物基础模型在表示学习、生成建模、数据集、预训练、下游评估和适配方面的进展与开放问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为聚合物信息学梳理了区别于通用科学基础模型的表示、生成、迁移和评估挑战，可作为材料模型选型与数据建设的路线图；但属于综述，未提供新的实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 基础模型已经成为一种强大的范式，能够从广泛且异质的数据中学习可迁移知识，并适配多样的下游任务，从而推动人们对 AI 加速科学发现的兴趣。在聚合物科学中，这一范式有望超越传统机器学习方法；后者通常局限于孤立任务，并且在数据稀缺和异质下游环境中难以泛化。然而，聚合物基础模型（PFM）并不只是应用于聚合物数据集的通用科学基础模型。它们必须应对聚合物信息学中特有的表示、生成、迁移和评估挑战。本综述综合了 PFM 在表示学习和生成建模方面的近期进展，涵盖为聚合物体系设计的模型以及从通用基础模型改造而来的模型。我们围绕两个阶段组织综述内容：（1）作为基础的聚合物建模，包括表示、数据集、模型架构和预训练目标；（2）下游应用、评估和适配。通过综合近期进展、开放挑战和未来方向，本文勾勒出构建稳健且可泛化的聚合物信息学基础模型的路线图。
items.author_line: Yihan Zhu, Eric Inae, Yuhan Liu, Weijiang Li, Sobin Alosious, Renzheng Zhang, Gang Liu, Tengfei Luo, Meng Jiang

items.title: Aligning Multimodal Patient Evidence with Biomedical Knowledge Graphs for Clinical LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Clinical questions often depend on linking a patient's multimodal evidence to external biomedical knowledge, yet existing predictive systems rarely represent such links explicitly, so they can neither be traced to their evidence sources nor removed to measure their contributions. We present MM-KG (Multimodal Knowledge Graph), which represents heterogeneous, multimodal patient observations and biomedical concepts as separate layers in one typed graph, joined by explicit alignment edges. First, modality-specific harmonizers convert EHR text, imaging, genomic, and biospecimen data into typed observations mapped to UMLS concepts, which a route-prioritized aligner links to a biomedical knowledge graph. Query-conditioned retrieval then selects a compact subgraph for downstream use by a large language model or a graph neural network. We build MM-KGs for MIMIC-IV and ADNI, and evaluate them with a 2x2 design that separates patient evidence, biomedical knowledge, and their interaction. On questions that require both sources, neither source alone performs far above chance, whereas their combination yields a drug-controlled AUROC interaction of +0.194 on MIMIC and +0.299 on ADNI. On held-out five-candidate ranking, MM-KG outperforms MindMap by +0.131 Hits@1 and leads an adapted GraphCare on the items that require consulting the patient, and deleting the single answer-bearing relation from the retrieved packet returns Hits@1 to the no-knowledge baseline. Finally, query-conditioned retrieval reaches 0.731 AUROC with 6.8x less context than the strongest generic policy, whereas static knowledge graph context gives no consistent gain on ordinary outcome prediction. Knowledge graphs thus benefit clinical LLMs not as background context but as explicit links between multimodal patient evidence and the relation a question requires, and MM-KG makes these links retrievable, traceable, and testable.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】MM-KG把患者的文本、影像、基因组和生物样本证据与生物医学知识图谱显式对齐，并在MIMIC-IV和ADNI上验证可追溯检索。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时处理患者证据、外部知识及二者交互，且通过删除答案关系进行可解释性干预；结果支持“显式关系”而非静态背景知识的临床LLM用法，但仍属于离线数据评估。
items.abstract_zh: 临床问题往往需要将患者的多模态证据与外部生物医学知识连接起来，但现有预测系统很少显式表示这种连接，因此既无法追溯证据来源，也无法移除这些连接来测量其贡献。我们提出MM-KG（Multimodal Knowledge Graph，多模态知识图谱），在一个类型化图中将异质的多模态患者观察和生物医学概念表示为分离的层，并通过显式对齐边连接起来。首先，针对不同模态的协调器将EHR文本、影像、基因组和生物样本数据转换为类型化观察，并映射到UMLS概念；随后，路线优先的对齐器将这些观察连接到生物医学知识图谱。查询条件化检索接着选择一个紧凑子图，供下游大型语言模型或图神经网络使用。我们为MIMIC-IV和ADNI构建了MM-KG，并采用2×2设计进行评估，以区分患者证据、生物医学知识及其交互。在需要两类来源的问题上，单独使用任一来源的表现都没有远高于机会水平，而二者结合后，在药物控制的AUROC交互项上，MIMIC提高了+0.194，ADNI提高了+0.299。在留出的五候选排序任务中，MM-KG比MindMap高出+0.131 Hits@1，并在需要查阅患者信息的条目上领先改造后的GraphCare；删除检索数据包中唯一承载答案的关系后，Hits@1回落到无知识基线。最后，查询条件化检索达到0.731 AUROC，所需上下文比最强的通用策略少6.8倍；相比之下，静态知识图谱上下文在普通结局预测上没有一致收益。因此，知识图谱对临床LLM的价值不在于充当背景上下文，而在于作为患者多模态证据与问题所需关系之间的显式连接；MM-KG使这些连接可检索、可追溯且可测试。

items.title: Capture of Post-Pluripotency Human Neuromesodermal and Neural Tube Axial Stem Cell States
items.abstract_or_text: The capture of pluripotent and adult tissue stem cells has transformed biomedicine, yet stable stem cell states between these developmental extremes have remained elusive. Here, we capture two human axial stem cell (AxSC) states corresponding to neuromesodermal and derivative neural tube progenitors. These states maintain telomere length without teratoma formation, and neuromesodermal AxSCs were recaptured from human embryonic tail buds. Mechanistically, genome-wide knockout screening and multiomics analyses revealed capture-associated acquisition of a stemness regulatory network with Trithorax-Polycomb dual functionality. Integration with genome-wide DNA methylation analysis identified a novel HOX timer driven by time-grouped DNA demethylation of target genes. Additionally, stage-specific glycolytic/OXPHOS remodeling in AxSCs was linked to bioenergetic pathways and histone acetylation dynamics. Finally, we captured mouse AxSCs that contribute to chimeras and exhibit an evolutionary divergent neuromesodermal-neural combined state. AxSCs are authentic post pluripotent stem cells for upscalable interrogation of development, with potential for regenerative medicine and drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】研究捕获了两种人类轴向干细胞（AxSC）状态，并结合全基因组敲除筛选、多组学、DNA甲基化和小鼠嵌合体实验解析其调控特征。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为多能与成体组织干细胞之间的发育过渡状态提供了可扩增模型，并有体内与跨物种证据；HOX计时器和Trithorax-Polycomb网络仍需进一步因果验证。
items.abstract_zh: 对多能干细胞和成体组织干细胞的捕获已经改变了生物医学，但位于这两个发育极端之间的稳定干细胞状态一直难以获得。在这里，我们捕获了两种人类轴向干细胞（AxSC）状态，分别对应神经中胚层祖细胞及其衍生的神经管祖细胞。这些状态能够维持端粒长度且不形成畸胎瘤；此外，还从人类胚胎尾芽中重新捕获了神经中胚层AxSC。机制上，全基因组敲除筛选和多组学分析显示，捕获相关过程获得了一个具有Trithorax-Polycomb双重功能的干性调控网络。将全基因组DNA甲基化分析整合后，发现一个由按时间分组的靶基因DNA去甲基化驱动的新型HOX计时器。此外，AxSC中的阶段特异性糖酵解/OXPHOS重塑与生物能量通路和组蛋白乙酰化动力学相关。最后，我们捕获了小鼠AxSC；这些细胞能够形成嵌合体，并表现出一种在进化上不同的神经中胚层—神经联合状态。AxSC是真正的多能之后干细胞，可用于可扩增地研究发育，并具有再生医学和药物发现潜力。

items.title: Integrated single-cell transcriptomic analysis reveals KLF6-associated macrophage-alveolar epithelial crosstalk in sepsis-associated acute lung injury
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Sepsis-associated acute lung injury (ALI) contributes substantially to sepsis mortality, but the cellular heterogeneity and molecular regulators driving its progression remain incompletely understood. This study integrated multiple public single-cell transcriptomic datasets to characterize pulmonary cellular remodeling and identify key regulators during sepsis-associated ALI. Methods Mouse lung scRNA-seq datasets (GSE207651, GSE249835, GSE278767; sham and CLP at 12, 24, and 48 h) were integrated with a human PBMC dataset (GSE279452, healthy controls vs. sepsis) and a mouse lung bulk RNA-seq dataset (GSE279484) used for validation. Data were processed in Seurat, with ambient RNA removed via scCDC/DecontX and cell types annotated using CellMarker 2.0. Compositional dynamics were assessed by RO/E ratios, and pathway/M1-M2 activity was scored with decoupleR. Monocyte/macrophage subclusters were characterized using AUCell, GSEApy, and Diffusion Pseudotime analysis. hdWGCNA, pySCENIC, and LIANA were applied to construct co-expression networks, TF regulatory networks, and cell communication maps, respectively; scTenifoldKnk validated candidate TFs in AT2 cells. A CLP mouse model with immunofluorescence staining validated KLF6/CD86 colocalization in vivo. Results Integrated analysis identified major pulmonary populations—including fibroblasts, endothelial cells, epithelial subtypes, and immune lineages that underwent time-dependent remodeling during CLP, particularly within innate immunity. Monocyte/macrophage populations showed pronounced M1/M2 heterogeneity, with M1 scores peaking early and M2 scores rising progressively toward 48 h. Pseudotime analysis revealed a continuous monocyte-to-M1 transition, and hdWGCNA identified associated co-expression modules (M1-M5, M1-M7, M1-M8), nominating Bhlhe40, Glul, and Klf6 as core candidate regulators. Klf6 showed highly specific regulatory activity in M1 macrophages, which communicated with AT2 and endothelial cells via multiple ligand-receptor axes. In PBMCs, a KLF6-high inflammatory monocyte subset was significantly expanded in sepsis and correlated with inflammation score. In AT2 cells, Fli1 and other TFs showed increased activity at CLP24h, with targets linked to vascular and tissue remodeling. Immunofluorescence confirmed increased KLF6⁺CD86⁺ cells in CLP-treated lungs. Conclusions This multi-omic integration delineates the dynamic remodeling of the pulmonary cellular landscape and monocyte/macrophage polarization in sepsis-associated ALI, identifying KLF6 as a key regulator linking macrophage M1 polarization to peripheral inflammatory monocyte activation offering new mechanistic insight and potential therapeutic targets.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】整合多套小鼠和人类单细胞数据，结合网络、转录因子和细胞通信分析，并用CLP小鼠免疫荧光验证KLF6/CD86共定位。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了脓毒症相关急性肺损伤中巨噬细胞—AT2细胞互作的多组学图景和KLF6候选调控线索；现有结果主要是关联性和候选机制，不能单独证明KLF6的因果作用。
items.abstract_zh: 脓毒症相关急性肺损伤（ALI）对脓毒症死亡负担很大，但驱动其进展的细胞异质性和分子调节因子仍未完全阐明。本研究整合多个人类和小鼠公共单细胞转录组数据集，以刻画脓毒症相关ALI期间的肺部细胞重塑并识别关键调节因子。小鼠肺scRNA-seq数据集（GSE207651、GSE249835、GSE278767；假手术和CLP后12、24及48小时）与人类PBMC数据集（GSE279452；健康对照与脓毒症）整合；另用小鼠肺bulk RNA-seq数据集（GSE279484）进行验证。数据在Seurat中处理，使用scCDC/DecontX去除环境RNA，并用CellMarker 2.0进行细胞类型注释。采用RO/E比值评估组成动态，用decoupleR对通路和M1-M2活性评分。单核细胞/巨噬细胞亚群通过AUCell、GSEApy和Diffusion Pseudotime进行表征；分别应用hdWGCNA、pySCENIC和LIANA构建共表达网络、TF调控网络和细胞通信图谱；用scTenifoldKnk在AT2细胞中验证候选TF。最后，在CLP小鼠模型中通过免疫荧光验证KLF6/CD86体内共定位。整合分析识别出成纤维细胞、内皮细胞、上皮细胞亚型和免疫细胞谱系等主要肺部群体；它们在CLP过程中发生了随时间变化的重塑，先天免疫变化尤其明显。单核细胞/巨噬细胞群体表现出显著的M1/M2异质性：M1评分早期达到峰值，M2评分则逐步升高并接近48小时。拟时序分析显示单核细胞持续向M1转变，hdWGCNA识别出相关共表达模块（M1-M5、M1-M7、M1-M8），并提名Bhlhe40、Glul和Klf6为核心候选调节因子。Klf6在M1巨噬细胞中显示出高度特异的调控活性；M1巨噬细胞通过多个配体—受体轴与AT2细胞和内皮细胞通信。在PBMC中，KLF6高表达的炎症性单核细胞亚群在脓毒症中显著扩增，并与炎症评分相关。在AT2细胞中，Fli1及其他TF在CLP24h时活性升高，其靶基因与血管和组织重塑相关。免疫荧光证实CLP处理肺组织中的KLF6⁺CD86⁺细胞增加。结论是，这种多组学整合描绘了脓毒症相关ALI中肺部细胞景观和单核细胞/巨噬细胞极化的动态重塑，识别出连接巨噬细胞M1极化与外周炎症性单核细胞激活的KLF6关键调节线索，并提出潜在治疗靶点。
items.author_line: Tan W, Chokkakula S, Huang H

items.title: Decoding autophagy-immune crosstalk in diabetic kidney disease: CCL2 as a central hub linking autophagic flux to macrophage polarization
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is a leading cause of end-stage renal disease. Autophagy maintains cellular homeostasis but is dysregulated in DKD. Both DKD and autophagy are closely linked to immune responses, yet the mechanistic crosstalk among them remains unclear. Methods We integrated multi‑cohort transcriptomic data and used machine learning to identify five autophagy‑associated feature genes (FOS, JUN, SOD1, CASP3, CCL2), which showed robust diagnostic performance in a training set and three external validation datasets (ROC analysis). Based on these five genes, we identified two autophagy‑related molecular subtypes of DKD with significant differences in immune response intensity and immune checkpoint expression. Single‑cell transcriptomics characterized the expression patterns and interactions of these features across renal cell populations. In DKD mouse models, we validated abnormal expression of the five genes and common autophagy markers by qPCR and Western blot, and demonstrated significant correlations between key features, autophagy indicators, and multiple renal function parameters. Results The five autophagy‑associated genes exhibited strong diagnostic value. The two DKD molecular subtypes differed markedly in immune response and checkpoint gene expression. Single‑cell analysis revealed distinct expression patterns across renal cell types. Animal studies confirmed dysregulation of the five genes and autophagy markers, as well as significant correlations with renal function parameters. Conclusions This study delineates the autophagy landscape in DKD and reveals its connection to immune microenvironment remodeling, providing potential biomarkers and strategic insights for stratified diagnosis and targeted intervention in DKD.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】整合多队列转录组、单细胞分析和DKD小鼠实验，识别FOS、JUN、SOD1、CASP3、CCL2五个自噬相关特征基因及两个分子亚型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把自噬特征与免疫微环境和肾功能指标联系起来，兼有外部数据集和动物验证；五基因诊断表现与免疫关联仍不能等同于已证实的治疗因果链。
items.abstract_zh: 糖尿病肾病（DKD）是终末期肾病的主要原因之一。自噬维持细胞稳态，但在DKD中发生失调。DKD和自噬都与免疫反应密切相关，然而三者之间的机制性交互仍不清楚。我们整合多队列转录组数据并使用机器学习，识别出5个自噬相关特征基因（FOS、JUN、SOD1、CASP3、CCL2）；这些基因在训练集和3个外部验证数据集的ROC分析中均表现出稳健的诊断能力。基于这5个基因，我们识别出两种自噬相关DKD分子亚型，它们在免疫反应强度和免疫检查点表达方面存在显著差异。单细胞转录组学刻画了这些特征在不同肾脏细胞群中的表达模式及相互作用。在DKD小鼠模型中，我们通过qPCR和Western blot验证了这5个基因及常见自噬标志物的异常表达，并证明关键特征、自噬指标和多项肾功能参数之间存在显著相关性。结果显示，这5个自噬相关基因具有较强诊断价值；两种DKD分子亚型在免疫反应和检查点基因表达方面明显不同。单细胞分析揭示了不同肾脏细胞类型中的差异表达模式。动物研究证实了这5个基因和自噬标志物的失调，以及它们与肾功能参数之间的显著相关性。结论是，本研究描绘了DKD中的自噬图谱，揭示其与免疫微环境重塑的联系，并为分层诊断和靶向干预提供潜在生物标志物及策略线索。
items.author_line: Li F, Wu Y, Ling J, Xia P, Liang J, Zheng X, Huang X, Xu M, Zhou Y, Yu P, Shen Y

items.title: A Modality-Invariant Measure of Neural Health
items.abstract_or_text: Quantifying neural health with a single measure remains a major unmet challenge. Here, we report a physiological marker based on the spatial distribution of signal-derived energy correlates in the resting brain. We hypothesize that energy organization in the healthy brain approaches an entropy-maximizing, homeostatically regulated state characterized by five properties: lognormal energy distributions, balanced spatial allocation, statistical independence between regions, low energy variance, and temporal stability. Together, these properties define an energetic profile that the Neural Health Index (NHI) summarizes as a single score, computable from (scalp/intracranial) electroencephalography, magnetoencephalography, or functional magnetic resonance imaging. Across 808 participants spanning neurological, psychiatric, neurodevelopmental, and neurodegenerative disorders, NHI distinguished healthy from clinical populations with sensitivity and specificity exceeding 95% in internal and external validation, scaled with disease severity, tracked pharmacological treatment exposure, and generalized to unseen diagnoses. These findings support NHI as a disease-agnostic, modality-invariant candidate biomarker for disease stratification and treatment monitoring.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint，临床】NHI从静息脑信号能量分布构建单一神经健康指标，在808名参与者及内外部验证中区分健康与多类临床人群。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨EEG、MEG和fMRI的统一候选生物标志物具有转化潜力，但当前证据仍是观察性验证，不能据此宣称疾病无关或治疗反应的因果指标。
items.abstract_zh: 用单一指标量化神经健康仍是一个尚未解决的重要挑战。在这里，我们报告了一种基于静息脑中信号衍生能量相关量空间分布的生理标志物。我们假设，健康大脑中的能量组织趋近于熵最大化、受稳态调节的状态，并具有五种性质：对数正态能量分布、平衡的空间分配、区域之间的统计独立性、较低的能量方差和时间稳定性。这些性质共同定义了一个能量特征，神经健康指数（NHI）将其概括为单一分数；该分数可由（头皮/颅内）脑电图、脑磁图或功能性磁共振成像计算。在涵盖神经系统、精神、神经发育和神经退行性疾病的808名参与者中，NHI在内部和外部验证中以超过95%的敏感度和特异度区分健康人群与临床人群；其数值随疾病严重程度变化，能够追踪药物治疗暴露，并推广到未见过的诊断类型。这些结果支持将NHI视为一种与疾病无关、与模态无关的候选生物标志物，用于疾病分层和治疗监测。
items.author_line: Sanchez Colon, L. A., Niebur, E., Kang, J., Onyike, C., Sarma, S.

items.title: Bridging the EHR Divide: Asymmetric Contrastive Learning for Cross-National Medical Representation Transfer
items.abstract_or_text: Cross-system transfer of longitudinal Electronic Health Record (EHR) representations is challenging because clinical coding, patient populations, and healthcare workflows differ substantially across institutions and countries. We introduce Asymmetric Supervised Contrastive Learning (Asymmetric SupCon), a task-specific pre-training objective motivated by the heterogeneity of negative clinical outcomes. The objective clusters patients sharing a target positive outcome without explicitly attracting negative trajectories toward one another. We pre-train temporal Transformer encoders on longitudinal records from 3.98 million patients in the Taiwanese National Health Insurance Research Database (NHIRD) and transfer them to two U.S. EHR datasets, MIMIC-IV and EHRSHOT. A hybrid semantic mapping pipeline combining direct mappings with embedding-based retrieval enables transfer across heterogeneous clinical vocabularies. On MIMIC-IV, NHIRD pre-training consistently improves over random initialization while substantially narrowing the performance gap to task-specific in-domain pre-training. On EHRSHOT, the transferred models show particularly strong few-shot performance for incident disease prediction. A controlled objective ablation shows that Asymmetric SupCon achieves the best AUPRC on three of four evaluated tasks and is 0.003 AUPRC below Standard SupCon on the fourth. These results support asymmetric contrastive pre-training as an effective approach for task-specific cross-national EHR representation transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/qingYzhang/Asymmetric_SupCon.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint，临床】Asymmetric SupCon在3.98百万名台湾NHIRD患者上预训练时间Transformer，并迁移到MIMIC-IV和EHRSHOT，评估跨国家EHR表示迁移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据规模大、跨体系迁移和目标函数消融较完整，提示非对称对比学习可缩小跨国EHR差距；仍需更多真实部署和前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 纵向电子健康记录（EHR）表示的跨系统迁移很有挑战，因为不同机构和国家在临床编码、患者群体及医疗工作流程方面存在显著差异。我们提出非对称监督式对比学习（Asymmetric Supervised Contrastive Learning，Asymmetric SupCon），这是一种受临床阴性结局异质性启发的任务特异性预训练目标。该目标将具有相同目标阳性结局的患者聚类，而不显式地把阴性轨迹相互吸引。我们在台湾全民健康保险研究数据库（NHIRD）的398万名患者纵向记录上预训练时间Transformer，并将其迁移到两个美国EHR数据集MIMIC-IV和EHRSHOT。一个结合直接映射与基于嵌入检索的混合语义映射流程，实现了异质临床词汇之间的迁移。在MIMIC-IV上，NHIRD预训练相较随机初始化持续改善，并显著缩小与任务特异性域内预训练之间的性能差距。在EHRSHOT上，迁移模型在新发疾病预测的少样本设置中表现尤其突出。受控目标消融显示，Asymmetric SupCon在4个评估任务中的3个上取得最高AUPRC，在第4个任务上比Standard SupCon低0.003 AUPRC。这些结果支持非对称对比预训练作为任务特异性跨国家EHR表示迁移的有效方法。代码见https://github.com/qingYzhang/Asymmetric_SupCon。
items.author_line: Qingyang Zhang

items.title: TrustMed-RL: Long-Horizon Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Diagnosis
items.abstract_or_text: Medical language models can produce correct diagnoses despite incomplete investigations and unsupported reasoning. To support long-horizon, evidence-grounded diagnosis, we introduce TrustMed-RL. Built from PubMed rare-disease cases and over 24,000 manually annotated image panels, it integrates interviews, examinations, testing, specialist consultation, and literature search through state-dependent actions. Our 8B vision--language policy, trained with clinically adapted GiGPO and coverage-adjusted diagnostic rewards, achieves 37.1\% diagnostic accuracy on 2,500 evaluation cases, outperforming all evaluated open-weight baselines and improving over supervised fine-tuning by 12.4 percentage points.. When success additionally requires acquiring at least 50\% of supporting test evidence, TrustMed-RL achieves 32.5\%, exceeding GPT-4o by 6.8 percentage points. Furthermore, it surpasses all evaluated baselines on MTMedDialog and multiple larger 27--32B models on AgentClinic. In physician review of 200 diagnostically accepted test-set trajectories, 83.0\% receive evidential-grounding scores of 4--5 out of 5. Physicians' assessments suggest that these diagnostic trajectories are trustworthy and aligned with human diagnostic reasoning.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint，临床】TrustMed-RL在稀有病病例、24,000多个手工标注影像面板和2,500个评估病例上训练长程证据驱动诊断策略，并进行医生轨迹评审。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把问诊、检查、会诊和文献搜索纳入状态依赖动作，兼顾诊断准确率与证据获取；评估仍基于病例和离线轨迹，不能替代临床试验。
items.abstract_zh: 医学语言模型有时能在检查不完整且推理缺乏支持的情况下给出正确诊断。为支持长程、证据驱动的诊断，我们提出TrustMed-RL。该方法基于PubMed稀有病病例和24,000多个手工标注的影像面板构建，将问诊、检查、测试、专科会诊和文献检索通过状态依赖动作整合起来。我们的8B视觉—语言策略使用临床适配的GiGPO和覆盖率调整的诊断奖励进行训练，在2,500个评估病例上达到37.1%的诊断准确率，超过所有评估的开放权重基线，并比监督微调提高12.4个百分点。当成功还要求获取至少50%的支持性检查证据时，TrustMed-RL达到32.5%，比GPT-4o高6.8个百分点。此外，它在MTMedDialog上超过所有评估基线，并在AgentClinic上超过多个更大的27–32B模型。在对200条诊断被接受的测试集轨迹进行医生评审时，83.0%的轨迹获得4–5分（满分5分）的证据支撑评分。医生评价表明，这些诊断轨迹可信，并且与人类诊断推理一致。
items.author_line: Wenxin Zhan, Yizheng Jiao, Haifeng Song, Shuai Xu, Chencheng Pan, Jiayi Feng, Anjie Xie

items.title: templar: agentic induction and evolution of standardized radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora
items.abstract_or_text: Structured radiology reporting mitigates the heterogeneity of free-text reports, yet its benefits depend on high-quality reporting templates. In practice, such templates are conventionally built through labor-intensive expert consensus and therefore vary across institutions and lag behind evolving clinical practice. Large language models (LLMs) enable automated template induction, but existing approaches remain limited: single-LLM induction is constrained by context length, and the corpus-scale method ASTAR produces a static, closed-corpus template without external grounding or downstream adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose TEMPLAR, a TEMPLate-centric Agentic framework for inducing and evolving standardized Radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora. TEMPLAR treats the template as a persistent central state maintained alongside two provenance-aware knowledge graphs, namely an anatomical graph that constrains template construction and a diagnostic graph that supports finding-to-diagnosis reasoning. Three agents operate on this state. The Induction Agent derives canonical clinical slots from anatomy-constrained Span-Triple atoms via dual-view similarity clustering; the Evolution Agent then assembles these slots into a hierarchical template and revises it under consistency constraints, external clinical evidence, and downstream structuring feedback; and the Clinical Agent applies the evolved template to report structuring, reconstruction, and diagnostic reasoning. Across four datasets, TEMPLAR outperforms ASTAR, three medical LLMs, and six general-purpose LLMs in coverage, information fidelity, and diagnostic fidelity, while achieving the highest or tied-highest LLM-rated template quality. Its fidelity advantages over ASTAR persist under cross-dataset transfer, and cumulative ablations support complementary contributions of its key components.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint，临床】TEMPLAR把模板作为持久中心状态，联合解剖图和诊断图，由诱导、演化、临床三个智能体从大规模影像报告语料中构建并迭代模板。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨四个数据集比较多个医学和通用LLM，并报告跨数据集迁移和累积消融，方法创新与可复现性较强；摘要未给出具体数据集规模和绝对指标。
items.abstract_zh: 结构化放射学报告可以缓解自由文本报告的异质性，但其收益取决于高质量报告模板。在实践中，这些模板通常通过耗费大量人工的专家共识构建，因此机构之间差异很大，也滞后于不断演变的临床实践。大型语言模型（LLM）能够自动诱导模板，但现有方法仍有限：单个LLM的诱导受上下文长度限制，语料规模方法ASTAR产生的是静态、封闭语料模板，缺乏外部支撑和下游适应能力。为解决这些问题，我们提出TEMPLAR——一种以模板为中心的智能体框架，用于从大规模临床语料中诱导和演化标准化放射学报告模板。TEMPLAR将模板作为持久的中心状态，并与两个具有来源信息的知识图谱共同维护：解剖图约束模板构建，诊断图支持从发现到诊断的推理。三个智能体在这一状态上运行。诱导智能体从受解剖约束的Span-Triple原子中，通过双视图相似性聚类提取规范化临床槽位；演化智能体随后将这些槽位组装为层级模板，并在一致性约束、外部临床证据和下游结构化反馈下进行修订；临床智能体则应用演化后的模板完成报告结构化、重建和诊断推理。在4个数据集上，TEMPLAR在覆盖率、信息保真度和诊断保真度方面超过ASTAR、3个医学LLM和6个通用LLM，同时获得最高或并列最高的LLM评定模板质量。相较ASTAR的保真度优势在跨数据集迁移时仍然存在，累积消融支持其关键组件的互补贡献。
items.author_line: Xiaotian Hu, Mingxuan Liu, Zhonghan Wang, Xinfeng Zhang, Yiming Huang, Ziang Wang, Kasidit Anmahaepong, Yijin Li, Yifei Chen, Hongjia Yang, Zihan Li, Qiyuan Tian

items.title: MedPrune: Topology-Efficient Multimodal Multi-Agent Communication Evolution for Medical VQA Tasks
items.abstract_or_text: While medical multimodal large language models (Med-MLLMs) advance medical visual question answering (VQA), existing clinical workflow-inspired multi-agent frameworks suffer from interaction patterns and excessive computational overhead caused by redundant communication topologies. In this paper, we propose MedPrune, an efficient medical multimodal multi-agent collaboration framework that dynamically prunes both nodes and edges from the communication topology to enhance reasoning ability and token efficiency. Specifically, we first formulate the diagnostic process as a heterogeneous communication graph, where nodes represent specialist agents from various departments and edges capture intra- and inter-departmental interactions. Building on this graph, we introduce two sparsification mechanisms to enable adaptive collaborative evolution: (1) Heterogeneous Node Sparsification, which eliminates task-irrelevant specialist agents irrelevant to the current multimodal question via reinforcement learning-driven topological optimization, and (2) Heterogeneous Edge Sparsification, which selectively retains only the most diagnostically salient intra- and inter-departmental connections by jointly optimizing task performance and topological complexity. Extensive medical VQA experiments under full-set and few-shot training settings prove MedPrune surpasses multi-agent baselines and boosts token efficiency with strong adversarial robustness.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint，临床】MedPrune将医疗VQA诊断流程建模为异质通信图，通过强化学习驱动的节点和边稀疏化降低多智能体通信拓扑和令牌开销。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时优化协作性能、拓扑复杂度和对抗鲁棒性，针对多智能体医疗推理的可扩展性；摘要未报告数据集规模及具体效率增益。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管医疗多模态大型语言模型（Med-MLLM）推动了医疗视觉问答（VQA）发展，但现有受临床工作流程启发的多智能体框架受到交互模式和冗余通信拓扑造成的过高计算开销影响。本文提出MedPrune，这是一种高效的医疗多模态多智能体协作框架，通过动态从通信拓扑中同时裁剪节点和边，增强推理能力并提高令牌效率。具体而言，我们首先将诊断过程表述为异质通信图，其中节点表示来自不同科室的专科智能体，边表示科室内和科室间的交互。在此图基础上，我们引入两种稀疏化机制以实现自适应协作演化：（1）异质节点稀疏化，利用强化学习驱动的拓扑优化，删除与当前多模态问题无关的专科智能体；（2）异质边稀疏化，通过联合优化任务性能和拓扑复杂度，只保留诊断上最重要的科室内及科室间连接。在完整集和少样本训练设置下的大量医疗VQA实验表明，MedPrune超过多智能体基线，并在保持较强对抗鲁棒性的同时提升令牌效率。
items.author_line: Jiuheng Wan, Runze Li, Chen Chen, Tingyuan Hu, Daiyang Yu, Yimin Jing, Taolin Zhang, Richang Hong

items.title: Ontology Concept Overlap as a Training Signal: Knowledge-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Clinical Question Answering
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning post-training for language models relies on two reward designs: human preferences (RLHF, DPO) and binary verifiers (RLVR). Clinical question answering fits neither. Near-correct answers differ by a single substituted entity, and no executable check decides clinical correctness. We instantiate a soft verifier from a maintained controlled vocabulary: UMLS Concept Unique Identifier overlap (via scispaCy, set-level F1) gives a graded, externally specified reward computed without a model in the loop. We combine it inside GRPO with an entropy-normalised LLM judge, which covers the safety and evidence axes overlap cannot see, and a small consistency penalty on padding and repetition that keeps early-training samples scorable. This three-term composite improves over SFT on Phi-3-mini (3.8B) over MedQA by 2.9% on EM (0.700 vs 0.680) and 39% on Token-F1 (0.202 vs 0.145); on Llama-3.2-3B the corresponding gains are 14% on EM and 35% on Token-F1. We report Token-F1 as the primary metric because it credits partially-correct clinical content that EM discards at this open-generation scale. Main-table results are means over 3 seeds with standard deviations below 0.005. The method transfers to PubMedQA, where training on the PubMedQA train set with the same composite reward improves Token-F1 over SFT by 22% on Phi-3-mini and 17% on Llama-3.2-3B without retuning. A reward ablation on Phi-3, varying the judge-ontology split at a fixed consistency weight, attributes 3 EM points to the ontology term, the contribution that catches entity substitutions the judge cannot. Three negative findings constrain the design: DPO under random negatives underperforms SFT for strong-prior models but helps the weakest-prior one; PPO under a sparse neural reward diverges; GRPO with KL-in-loss collapses at 7B.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint，临床】该方法把UMLS Concept Unique Identifier集合F1作为软验证器，与熵归一化LLM评审和一致性惩罚结合，在MedQA和PubMedQA上改进生成式临床问答。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 用可外部指定的本体重叠奖励捕获实体替换错误，并通过消融和多随机种子验证；收益来自基准任务，尚不能代表临床安全性。
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型的强化学习后训练依赖两类奖励设计：人类偏好（RLHF、DPO）和二元验证器（RLVR）。临床问题问答不完全适合其中任何一种。近似正确的答案可能只差一个被替换的实体，而且没有可执行的检查能够判定临床正确性。我们从一个持续维护的受控词汇表中实例化了软验证器：UMLS Concept Unique Identifier重叠（通过scispaCy计算集合级F1）提供一种分级、外部指定的奖励，计算过程中不需要模型参与。我们在GRPO中将其与熵归一化的LLM评审结合；后者覆盖重叠指标无法识别的安全性和证据维度；同时加入一个针对填充和重复的小型一致性惩罚，使早期训练样本仍可评分。在MedQA上，与Phi-3-mini（3.8B）的SFT相比，该三项复合奖励使EM提高2.9%（0.700对0.680），Token-F1提高39%（0.202对0.145）；在Llama-3.2-3B上，相应的EM提高14%，Token-F1提高35%。我们将Token-F1作为主要指标，因为在开放生成规模下，它会为部分正确的临床内容计分，而EM会丢弃这类内容。主表结果是3个随机种子的均值，标准差低于0.005。该方法迁移到PubMedQA时，在相同复合奖励下训练PubMedQA训练集，相比SFT，Phi-3-mini的Token-F1提高22%，Llama-3.2-3B提高17%，无需重新调参。在Phi-3上进行奖励消融，在固定一致性权重下改变评审器—本体划分，结果将3个EM百分点归因于本体项；该项能捕捉评审器无法发现的实体替换。三个阴性结果限制了设计：随机负样本下的DPO在强先验模型上低于SFT，但能帮助最弱先验模型；稀疏神经奖励下的PPO发散；带损失中KL项的GRPO在7B规模时崩溃。

items.title: lisaR: An LLM-Inferred Semantic Annotation of biological categories for gene set enrichment analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) turns differential expression results into lists of enriched gene sets. These lists are often long and redundant and span several gene-set collections, which makes their biological interpretation difficult. We present lisaR, an R package that reads previously computed differential expression or differential abundance results, runs GSEA and organises the output with the LISA dictionaries (LLM-Inferred Semantic Annotation). The dictionaries place 13,511 gene sets from the three Gene Ontology branches and from curated pathway collections such as Reactome, WikiPathways, KEGG, BioCarta and PID in 158 biological categories grouped into 42 supercategories within four dictionaries. Four open-weight language models scored the semantic fit of each gene set to the categories, and a consensus rule selected the assignments. The dictionaries are distributed with the package and do not depend on the data: studies analysed at different times with the same dictionaries are interpreted with the same categories, and no language model is queried during an analysis. For each category, lisaR summarises the direction of its significant gene sets and applies closed testing with Hommel's robust procedure, which states whether the category shows evidence of enrichment and gives a simultaneous lower bound on how many of its gene sets are enriched. lisaR results are summarised in a report that opens in a web browser and leads from each category to its gene sets and genes, with every figure saved together with its data and R code. We illustrate the workflow with RNA-seq from melanoma biopsies taken before and during nivolumab treatment and with paired tumour and adjacent-tissue proteomics from clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Availability: lisaR is available at https://github.com/DBM-OlmedaLab/lisaR and archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23044930; documentation at https://olmedalab.org/lisaR/.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】lisaR用LLM预先为13,511个基因集建立语义类别字典，并在分析时离线组织GSEA结果，配合闭合检验、可追溯报告和可复现代码。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将冗长、冗余的富集结果压缩为可解释层级，同时避免分析过程中再次调用模型；字典质量依赖预先的模型评分和共识规则。
items.abstract_zh: 基因集富集分析（GSEA）将差异表达结果转换为富集基因集列表。这些列表通常很长且存在冗余，并跨越多个基因集集合，使其生物学解释变得困难。我们提出lisaR，这是一个R软件包，读取已经计算的差异表达或差异丰度结果，运行GSEA，并使用LISA字典（LLM-Inferred Semantic Annotation，大语言模型推断的语义注释）组织输出。这些字典将来自3个Gene Ontology分支以及Reactome、WikiPathways、KEGG、BioCarta和PID等整理型通路集合的13,511个基因集，放入158个生物学类别；这些类别分为42个超类别，分布在4个字典中。4个开放权重语言模型为每个基因集与类别的语义匹配度评分，并通过共识规则选择归属。字典随软件包分发且不依赖数据：在不同时间分析的研究使用相同字典时，将以相同类别进行解释，并且分析过程中不查询语言模型。对于每个类别，lisaR汇总其显著基因集的方向，并采用Hommel稳健程序进行闭合检验；该检验判断类别是否存在富集证据，并给出该类别中富集基因集数量的同时下界。lisaR结果汇总为可在网页浏览器中打开的报告，用户可以从每个类别追溯到其基因集和基因；每幅图都会与其数据和R代码一同保存。我们用黑色素瘤活检样本在nivolumab治疗前和治疗期间的RNA-seq，以及透明细胞肾细胞癌配对肿瘤与邻近组织的蛋白质组学，示范了这一流程。可用性：lisaR见https://github.com/DBM-OlmedaLab/lisaR，并存档于https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23044930；文档见https://olmedalab.org/lisaR/。

items.title: Explainable Machine Learning for Prevalent Cardiovascular Disease Stratification Using Clinical, Sociodemographic, and Lifestyle Data: Temporal Validation in NHANES
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background: Machine-learning methods can capture nonlinear associations in multidomain health data, but discrimination alone does not establish the reliability of probability-based disease stratification. Calibration, temporal transportability, threshold-dependent behavior, subgroup heterogeneity, and model interpretability require separate evaluation. Objective: To develop and temporally validate an explainable machine-learning framework for stratifying prevalent physiciandiagnosed cardiovascular disease (CVD), while evaluating discrimination, probability calibration, decision-analytic behavior, subgroup robustness, and explanation stability. Methods: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) data from 2007–2018 were analyzed. Adults aged ≥ 20 years with a known composite CVD outcome were included. Prevalent CVD was defined from self-reported physician diagnoses of congestive heart failure, coronary heart disease, angina, heart attack, or stroke. NHANES 2007–2012 constituted the development period and 2013–2018 the chronologically later temporal-validation period. Logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM were compared and tuned using development-only five-fold cross-validation. XGBoost was selected according to the predefined development ROC-AUC ranking criterion. A sigmoid calibration mapping and a Youden-derived analytical operating point were established using development data and locked before temporal evaluation. The uncalibrated and isotonic probability outputs were retained as sensitivity analyses. Temporal evaluation included ROC-AUC, average precision, Brier score, log loss, calibration intercept and slope, bootstrap confidence intervals, threshold-dependent metrics, decision-curve analysis, predictor-domain ablation, subgroup analysis, and SHAP-based explainability. Results: The analytical cohort included 34,602 adults: 17,626 in development and 16,976 in temporal validation. The locked sigmoid-calibrated XGBoost achieved a temporal ROC-AUC of 0.847 (95% CI 0.839–0.856) and average precision of 0.403 (95% CI 0.382–0.427), compared with a prevalence baseline of approximately 0.113. The Brier score was 0.083 (95% CI 0.080–0.086), calibration intercept was −0.067 (95% CI −0.164 to 0.038), and calibration slope was 0.981 (95% CI 0.943–1.022). The uncalibrated XGBoost had a lower temporal Brier score (0.0809), indicating that the sigmoid layer did not improve overall probability accuracy. At the development-locked analytical operating point of 0.0760, sensitivity was 0.820, specificity 0.718, positive predictive value 0.270, and negative predictive value 0.969. Operating characteristics varied substantially by age. Age was the dominant SHAP predictor, and original-predictor importance rankings were stable across temporal cycles (pairwise Spearman ρ= 0.982–0.996). Conclusions: The development-locked framework maintained useful discrimination and near-ideal aggregate calibration when transported chronologically to later NHANES cycles, although sigmoid calibration did not improve the Brier score relative to the uncalibrated model. Social-context and lifestyle/exposure variables provided modest incremental predictive information beyond the core clinical-demographic predictors. Because the outcome was prevalent physician-diagnosed CVD rather than prospective cardiovascular events, the model should be interpreted as a prevalent-CVD status-stratification framework rather than a longitudinal event-risk calculator. Independent external and prospective validation, including purpose-specific threshold development, is required before clinical use.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint，临床】在NHANES 2007–2018的34,602名成年人中，锁定开发期的校准XGBoost进行时间验证，并系统评估判别、校准、阈值、亚组和解释稳定性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 报告了时间外推、校准和决策曲线，而非只报AUC；结局是既往医生诊断的患病状态，不是前瞻性事件风险，作者也明确要求独立外部和前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习方法能够捕捉多领域健康数据中的非线性关联，但仅有判别能力并不能证明基于概率的疾病分层可靠。校准、时间可迁移性、依赖阈值的行为、亚组异质性和模型可解释性需要分别评估。目的：开发并进行时间验证一种可解释的机器学习框架，用于分层预测既往由医生诊断的心血管疾病（CVD），同时评估判别能力、概率校准、决策分析行为、亚组稳健性和解释稳定性。方法：分析2007–2018年的National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey（NHANES）数据。纳入年龄≥20岁且具有已知复合CVD结局的成年人。患病CVD根据自报的充血性心力衰竭、冠心病、心绞痛、心脏病发作或卒中医生诊断定义。NHANES 2007–2012作为开发期，2013–2018作为按时间顺序划分的后续时间验证期。比较逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost和LightGBM，并仅使用开发数据进行5折交叉验证调参。根据预先规定的开发期ROC-AUC排序标准选择XGBoost。使用开发数据建立sigmoid校准映射和Youden推导的分析工作点，并在时间评估前锁定。保留未校准和等距回归概率输出作为敏感性分析。时间评估包括ROC-AUC、平均精确率、Brier分数、对数损失、校准截距和斜率、bootstrap置信区间、依赖阈值的指标、决策曲线分析、预测因子领域消融、亚组分析和基于SHAP的可解释性。结果：分析队列包含34,602名成年人：开发集17,626人，时间验证集16,976人。锁定的sigmoid校准XGBoost在时间验证中达到0.847的ROC-AUC（95% CI 0.839–0.856）和0.403的平均精确率（95% CI 0.382–0.427），而患病率基线约为0.113。Brier分数为0.083（95% CI 0.080–0.086），校准截距为−0.067（95% CI −0.164至0.038），校准斜率为0.981（95% CI 0.943–1.022）。未校准XGBoost的时间Brier分数更低（0.0809），表明sigmoid层没有改善总体概率准确度。在开发期锁定的0.0760分析工作点上，敏感度为0.820，特异度为0.718，阳性预测值为0.270，阴性预测值为0.969。工作特征随年龄显著变化。年龄是SHAP中最重要的预测因子，原始预测因子的重要性排序在不同时间周期之间保持稳定（成对Spearman ρ=0.982–0.996）。结论：该开发期锁定框架在按时间迁移到后续NHANES周期时保持了有用的判别能力和近乎理想的总体校准，尽管相对于未校准模型，sigmoid校准并未改善Brier分数。社会背景和生活方式/暴露变量在核心临床—人口学预测因子之外提供了适度的增量预测信息。由于结局是既往由医生诊断的患病CVD，而不是前瞻性心血管事件，该模型应被解释为患病CVD状态分层框架，而不是纵向事件风险计算器。在临床使用前，仍需要独立的外部和前瞻性验证，包括针对具体目的的阈值开发。

items.title: AIProver: Agentic Auto-Formalization of Mathematical Research via Certificate-Driven Evolving Harness
items.abstract_or_text: Proof auto-formalization translates natural-language (NL) theorems and proofs into a formal language (FL) such as Lean, enabling mechanical verification. Despite rapid progress, research-level proofs often depend on concepts missing from leading proof assistant libraries (e.g., Lean's Mathlib), and successful compilation does not guarantee that a translation preserves the theorem's meaning or the proof's reasoning. Furthermore, aligned NL-FL training data are scarce, and leading agents often rely on costly frontier models and manually engineered harnesses. To address the above issues, we present AIProver, an agentic framework for autonomous proof auto-formalization and proof synthesis (AFPS) that jointly post-trains a 119B open-weight language model and evolves its agentic, tool-calling harness with HarnessEvolve. Verifiers assess type correctness, proof completeness, and semantic correctness, returning rewards and diagnostic certificates that drive model fine-tuning and alternating reinforcement learning via symbolic feedback and HarnessEvolve, a certificate-driven evolutionary search over the whole harness control flow that re-tailors the harness to the updated model. For research-level training and evaluation, we introduce LoCoBench, 58.9k instances from Mathlib, CSLib, Mizar Math Library, and a bounded-arithmetic textbook, with a 771-instance validation split whose theorem-proof pairs have no public Lean formalization. Against 39 frameworks spanning AFPS agents, frontier LLMs, and coding agents, AIProver lifts pass@4 semantic correctness over its Leanstral-1.5 base from 15.7% to 36.7% and outperforms every other open-weight system and Aristotle. As a Claude Code and Codex skill, it lifts their semantic correctness from 41.9% and 34.1% to 79.8% and 62.4%, respectively. Further, it is also 24% cheaper than Numina-Lean-Agent, pushing the accuracy-cost frontier of research-level AFPS.
items.summary_zh: AIProver 将 119B 开放权重模型、证书驱动验证和 HarnessEvolve 结合，用于研究级证明自动形式化与证明合成；LoCoBench 和语义正确性指标提供了较清晰的外部评测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作同时检验类型正确性、证明完整性和语义正确性，避免把“成功编译”直接等同于数学正确；公开的 771 项无 Lean 形式化验证集也提高了结果的可检验性。

items.category: 证明助手与自动形式化
items.abstract_zh: 证明自动形式化将自然语言（NL）定理和证明转换为 Lean 等形式语言（FL），从而实现机械验证。尽管进展迅速，研究级证明往往依赖领先证明助手库中缺失的概念（例如 Lean 的 Mathlib），而成功编译也不能保证翻译保留了定理含义或证明推理。此外，对齐的 NL-FL 训练数据稀缺，领先智能体常依赖昂贵的前沿模型和手工设计的 harness。为解决这些问题，我们提出 AIProver：一个用于自主证明自动形式化和证明合成（AFPS）的智能体框架，它联合后训练一个 119B 开放权重语言模型，并利用 HarnessEvolve 演化其智能体工具调用 harness。验证器评估类型正确性、证明完整性和语义正确性，返回奖励与诊断证书，驱动模型微调，并通过符号反馈和 HarnessEvolve 交替进行强化学习；HarnessEvolve 是一种由证书驱动、在整个 harness 控制流上进行的演化搜索，会针对更新后的模型重新定制 harness。针对研究级训练和评测，我们引入 LoCoBench：包含来自 Mathlib、CSLib、Mizar Math Library 和一本有界算术教材的 58.9k 个实例，其中 771 个实例的验证集里的定理—证明对没有公开 Lean 形式化。与涵盖 AFPS 智能体、前沿 LLM 和编程智能体的 39 个框架比较，AIProver 将 Leanstral-1.5 基线的 pass@4 语义正确性从 15.7% 提升到 36.7%，并超过其他所有开放权重系统和 Aristotle。作为 Claude Code 和 Codex 技能，它分别将二者的语义正确性从 41.9% 和 34.1% 提升到 79.8% 和 62.4%。此外，它比 Numina-Lean-Agent 便宜 24%，推进了研究级 AFPS 的准确率—成本前沿。
